rationale: Freeze the current duplicate-dependency report budget and crate identity set so dependency graph growth or crate swaps are explicit while existing duplicate-version debt is burned down in focused tasks. Tree output line count remains report-only because cargo tree text formatting can vary across toolchains. Task #3235 approves only the 11 crypto-family identities listed in approved_duplicate_provenance: each is an unavoidable old/new transitive closure while libp2p/aliyun-tablestore/Wasmtime/tungstenite and the first-party crypto majors resolve concurrently; no aggregate maxima increase is justified.
update_policy: Only raise a maximum or approve a new duplicate crate with repository-health review evidence, a task execution-log entry, and a follow-up burn-down rationale. Every approved exception must carry approved_duplicate_provenance with task UID, evidence command/report, owner, expiry, affected crate identities, and a concrete burn-down trigger. Lower maxima and remove stale crate entries when dependency cleanup removes duplicates.

approved_duplicate_provenance.burn_down_trigger: Re-run the governance report at expiry or after a libp2p, aliyun-tablestore-rs, Wasmtime, tungstenite, or first-party crypto-major upgrade; remove each exception as soon as its old/new transitive closure converges.
